- Use natural Latvian progress and status wording rather than copying English -ing forms. Use an ellipsis for an ongoing action; handle changing numbers with Latvian plural forms or a number-neutral construction. (Notiek pārbaude…; Notiek {n} lejupielādes)
- Write error messages in natural Latvian. A fragment can follow a colon; retain the error placeholder unchanged. (Nevarēja atvērt: {error})
- Write event-log entries as concise, complete past-tense statements. Match participles to the grammatical gender and number of the subject. (Lejupielāde pabeigta.; Fails saglabāts.)
- Use sentence case: capitalize the first word and proper names, not every word in a heading. Write weekdays and month names with lowercase initials. (Lejupielādes iestatījumi; pirmdiena, 14. maijs)

- Use one space after punctuation and none before it. Use a space between a number and a unit or percent sign; keep the ellipsis attached to the preceding word. (10 %; 5 MB)

- When a subject is implied, make the verb or participle agree with the understood subject. Prefer wording that makes the subject clear when agreement could be ambiguous. (Lejupielāde apturēta.; Fails lejupielādēts.)

- Use natural Latvian word order and inflection. Do not reproduce English noun stacks; express relationships with Latvian cases or a prepositional phrase. (Lejupielādes ātruma ierobežojums; Fails no servera)
- Prefer established Latvian terms to English loanwords. Use a loanword only when it is established or needed for a technical term, and inflect it according to Latvian grammar. (saite; serveris)
- Keep product names, file names, URLs, and placeholders unchanged unless the product’s approved terminology specifies otherwise. (Dannex Download Manager; {fileName})
- Use Latvian date and time conventions. In a full date, use the genitive form of the month after the day; retain the period after an ordinal day number. (2025. gada 14. maijā; 14. maijs)

mi.note: How Maori writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Whakamahia te kupu mahi hei whakahau. Whakamahia te whakahau hāngū ina whakaingoatia te mea ka pāngia. (Tikiake; Tikiakehia te kōnae.)
- Kia poto ngā pātene, kia mārama hoki te mahi ka mahia. (Okioki; Whakatū anō)
- I ngā tahua, tīmata ki te kupu mahi mō tētahi mahi; whakamahia he ingoa mō tētahi wāhanga tautuhinga. (Whakatuwhera te kōpaki; Tautuhinga)
- Tuhia te pouaka taki hei mahi, hei tautuhinga rānei; kaua e tāpiri i te ingoa “pouaka taki”. (Whakatuwhera aunoa i ngā kōnae kua tikiakehia)
- Kōrero tika, māori hoki ki te kaiwhakamahi. Kāore he rerekētanga ōkawa, ōpaki rānei o te kupu “koe”; kaua e whakamahi ina mārama kē te kōrero. (Ka taea e koe te kōwhiri i tētahi kōpaki.)

- Use natural Malayalam word order rather than copying English word order. Place modifiers before the noun and keep the main verb at the end where natural. (പൂർത്തിയായ ഡൗൺലോഡുകൾ; ഫയൽ ഡൗൺലോഡ് ചെയ്യുക)
- Use a concise ongoing-action form for progress messages. Preserve placeholders, but rearrange them if needed for natural Malayalam. (പരിശോധിക്കുന്നു…; {n} ഡൗൺലോഡുകൾ പുരോഗമിക്കുന്നു)

- Malayalam has no upper- and lowercase distinction. Do not imitate English title case; retain the prescribed spelling of product names and acronyms. (ഡൗൺലോഡ് ക്രമീകരണങ്ങൾ; Windows)
- Use Malayalam names for months and weekdays; capitalization does not apply. (ജനുവരി; തിങ്കളാഴ്ച)

- Use punctuation to clarify meaning, not to mirror English mechanically. Put no space before punctuation and one space after it where a space is needed. (സ്ഥിതി: പൂർത്തിയായി; ഡൗൺലോഡ് ചെയ്തു. അടുത്ത ഫയൽ ആരംഭിക്കുന്നു.)

- प्रचलित तांत्रिक कर्जशब्द देवनागरीत लिहा; परिचित मराठी पर्याय असल्यास तो प्राधान्याने वापरा. उत्पादननावे, फाइल विस्तार आणि प्रोटोकॉलचे लॅटिन रूप बदलू नका. (डाउनलोड; दुवा)

ms.note: How Malay writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Tulis arahan sebagai kata kerja perintah, biasanya tanpa subjek atau kata sopan tambahan. (Pilih folder destinasi; Masukkan URL)
- Mulakan label butang dengan kata kerja yang menyatakan tindakan; jangan letakkan tanda noktah. (Tambah muat turun; Jeda)
- Gunakan frasa ringkas untuk item menu; gunakan kata kerja untuk tindakan dan kata nama untuk destinasi atau kategori. (Sambung semula; Tetapan)
- Tulis label kotak semak sebagai pilihan atau keadaan yang jelas, bukan sebagai arahan kepada pengguna. (Mulakan muat turun apabila Windows bermula; Tutup tetingkap selepas muat turun selesai)

- Sapa pengguna dengan anda. Kekalkan nada neutral, profesional dan terus; elakkan bahasa terlalu santai atau berbunga-bunga. (Anda boleh menyambung semula muat turun kemudian; Pilih folder yang anda mahu gunakan)

- Bentuk soalan pengesahan sebagai soalan yang jelas dan sopan, lazimnya dengan Adakah anda mahu; nyatakan tindakan yang akan berlaku. (Adakah anda mahu memadam fail ini?; Adakah anda mahu menghentikan semua muat turun?)
- Gunakan frasa nama yang padat untuk label dan tajuk lajur. Elakkan kata sandang dan kata depan yang tidak diperlukan. (Nama fail; Saiz)
- Gunakan bentuk yang ringkas dan konsisten untuk status serta kemajuan; kekalkan penanda tempat dan jangan tambah bentuk jamak pada kata nama. (Sedang menyemak…; Memuat turun {n} fail)
- Untuk status selesai atau gagal, nyatakan hasil dengan ringkas dan gunakan bentuk pasif jika pelaku tidak penting. (Muat turun selesai; Fail telah disimpan)
- Tulis mesej ralat dalam ayat Melayu yang lengkap. Letakkan butiran ralat selepas penerangan dan titik bertindih. (Tidak dapat membuka fail: {error}; Tidak dapat menyambung ke pelayan.)
- Jadikan baris log ringkas dan berorientasikan peristiwa; letakkan cap masa dahulu jika tersedia. (10:32 Muat turun selesai; 10:33 Sambungan terputus)
- Gunakan huruf besar pada perkataan pertama ayat dan nama khas sahaja. Nama bulan dan hari ditulis dengan huruf kecil. (Muat turun selesai pada isnin, 12 januari.; Microsoft Windows)

- Gunakan tanda baca Melayu secara konsisten: tiada ruang sebelum tanda baca dan satu ruang selepasnya. Gunakan elipsis untuk teks yang sedang berlangsung. (Sedang menyambung…; Ralat: sambungan gagal)
- Gunakan tanda petik berganda untuk memetik teks UI atau nilai yang dirujuk. Jangan sisipkan ruang di dalam tanda petik. (Pilih “Simpan sebagai”.; Nilai “Automatik” digunakan.)

- Bahasa Melayu tidak mengubah kata kerja mengikut bilangan atau jantina subjek. Kekalkan kata kerja yang sama dan gunakan bentuk pasif apabila objek menjadi tumpuan. (Fail sedang dimuat turun; Fail sedang dimuat turun)
- Ikut susunan ayat Melayu yang lazim; letakkan penerang selepas kata nama dan jangan meniru susunan bahasa Inggeris secara langsung. (folder sementara; Muat turun fail dengan pantas)
- Utamakan istilah Melayu yang mantap. Kekalkan nama produk dan istilah teknikal yang tiada padanan lazim; jangan campurkan bahasa Inggeris tanpa keperluan. (pautan muat turun; Microsoft Edge)
- Kekalkan pemegang tempat, pemboleh ubah dan format data tepat seperti sumber; susun semula ayat di sekelilingnya jika perlu. (Tidak dapat membuka fail: {error}; Muat turun {n} fail)

mt.note: How Maltese writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Use the direct, concise style of Windows interface text. Address the user as singular ‘you’; normally omit the pronoun and use a direct imperative for an action. (Agħżel folder.; Daħħal l-indirizz.)
- Phrase action commands as imperatives. Keep the verb first where natural; use the same wording for the same action throughout the app. (Ibda t-tniżżil.; Iftaħ il-ħolqa.)
- Use concise imperatives for buttons. Use a noun only when it names a destination or a setting rather than an action. (Issospendi; Settings)
- Phrase menu actions as imperatives; phrase menu headings as short nouns. (Żid tniżżil; Fajl)
- Make check box text a short statement describing the option’s effect, not a command to the user. (Uri t-tniżżil komplut)
- Use direct confirmation questions with a question mark. Do not add a separate ‘Are you sure?’ when the action can be named clearly. (Trid tħassar dan it-tniżżil?)
- Keep labels and column headings short, usually as noun phrases without an article. Use prepositions when they clarify the relationship. (Isem; Daqs)
- Use concise status wording. For an ongoing action, use ‘qed’ with the verb; use a noun phrase when it reads more naturally. (Qed jiċċekkja…; Tniżżil għaddej)
- Make number agreement clear in progress and status text. Prefer naming the counted items instead of leaving a number next to a verb whose agreement is unclear. (Qed jitniżżlu {n} fajls)
- In fragments with an implied subject, make the verb agree with the understood noun. If the subject is unclear, recast the text as a noun phrase. (Qed jitniżżel il-fajl.; Qed issir verifika.)
- Keep error messages brief and specific. Use a colon before a supplied error detail; make the verb agree with the item named or implied. (Ma setax jinfetaħ: {error})
- Write event log entries as concise, complete statements, normally in the past tense. Include a full stop for a sentence. (It-tniżżil beda.)
- Use sentence case, not English-style title case. Capitalize the first word and proper names; keep month and weekday names lowercase in running text. (Settings tat-tniżżil; it-Tnejn, 12 ta’ jannar)

- Use Maltese spelling and diacritics, including ċ, ġ, ħ, ż, and the Maltese apostrophe where required. Preserve the spelling of filenames, URLs, and product names. (Iċċekkja għal aġġornamenti; Fajl ‘setup.exe’)
- Use one space between words and after punctuation, never before commas, full stops, colons, or question marks. Do not put a space before an ellipsis. (Żball: il-fajl ma nfetaħx.; Qed jiċċekkja…)
- Use typographic double quotation marks for quoted interface text where supported. Do not use quotation marks around ordinary labels or button names. (Il-messaġġ “Tniżżil lest” intwera.)
- Use the apostrophe consistently in Maltese contractions and elisions; do not add spaces around it. (ta’ dan il-fajl; l-indirizz)
- Prefer natural Maltese word order, putting the action or key information early. Avoid copying English word order if it sounds unnatural. (Agħżel il-folder fejn trid issalva l-fajl.)

- Prefer established Maltese technical terms. Use a familiar loanword when it is established in computing; avoid inserting English just because it is shorter. Keep product names and technical identifiers unchanged. (aġġornament; folder)

- Keep placeholders unchanged and place them where Maltese grammar requires. Avoid making a placeholder carry an ending or a gender that cannot be guaranteed. (Qed jitniżżlu {n} fajls.; Żball: {error})

nb.note: How Norwegian Bokmål writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Bruk infinitiv eller den vanlige kommandoformen for kommandoer, knapper og menyvalg. Velg en kort, tydelig handling. (Lagre; Legg til nedlasting)
- Skriv avmerkingsboksens tekst som en kort påstand eller handling, ikke som en kommando til brukeren. La avmerkingsboksen stå for valget. (Start nedlastingen automatisk; Vis varsler)
- Henvend deg direkte til brukeren med «du» når det trengs. Bruk en vennlig, saklig tone; unngå «De» og unødvendig tiltale. (Du kan endre dette senere.; Velg en mappe.)
- Formuler bekreftelsesspørsmål som tydelige spørsmål. Bruk helst knapper med handlingstekst framfor generelle svar som «Ja» og «Nei». (Vil du avbryte nedlastingen?; Avbryt nedlasting)
- Bruk korte substantivfraser uten unødvendige artikler i etiketter og kolonneoverskrifter. Bruk preposisjoner når de tydeliggjør forholdet. (Filnavn; Størrelse)
- Bruk presens for pågående aktivitet og en kort, naturlig statusform. Sørg for at plassholdere passer grammatisk inn i teksten. (Kontrollerer …; Laster ned {n} filer)
- Skriv feilmeldinger klart og konkret. Ta med hva som ikke kunne gjøres, og behold eventuell feilinformasjon i en tydelig avgrenset del. (Kan ikke åpne filen: {error}.)
- Skriv hendelsesloggoppføringer som korte, informative setninger. Bruk fortid eller en fullført-status som passer hendelsen. (Nedlastingen er fullført.; Tilkoblingen ble avbrutt.)
- Bruk setningskasus i titler og overskrifter: stor forbokstav i første ord og i egennavn, ellers små bokstaver. (Legg til nedlasting; Innstillinger for Dannex Download Manager)
- Skriv ukedager og månedsnavn med liten forbokstav. (mandag; oktober)

- Bruk norsk tegnsetting. Sett ikke mellomrom før komma, punktum eller kolon; bruk mellomrom etter dem. Bruk punktum i fullstendige setninger, men vanligvis ikke i knappeetiketter og korte statuser. (Nedlastingen er fullført.; Klar)
- Bruk norske anførselstegn («…») når ord eller tekst omtales som tekst. Ikke bruk anførselstegn bare for å fremheve et grensesnittelement. (Skriv «nedlasting» i søkefeltet.)
- Bruk ett tegn for ellipsen («…») i tekst som fortsetter eller venter. Ikke legg til ellipser som ren pynt. (Kobler til …; Kontrollerer …)
- La statusord samsvare grammatisk med et underforstått substantiv, eller skriv om statusen så den ikke krever synlig samsvar. (Nedlastingen er satt på pause.; Pauset)
- Følg norsk ordstilling, særlig verbet på andre plass i hovedsetninger. Unngå engelsk ordstilling og lange, tunge nominalfraser. (Nedlastingen starter automatisk.; Velg hvor filen skal lagres.)
- Bruk etablerte norske ord framfor engelske lånord når de er naturlige. Behold produktnavn og nødvendige forkortelser uendret. (mappe, ikke «folder»; Dannex Download Manager)
- Bruk samme term for samme funksjon gjennom hele grensesnittet, og følg termlisten nedenfor. (Bruk «kobling» konsekvent for en lenke i grensesnittet.)

ne.note: How Nepali writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Use polite, direct instructions. Address the user as तपाईं when needed; usually omit the pronoun and use the respectful imperative ending गर्नुहोस्. (डाउनलोड सुरु गर्न डाउनलोड गर्नुहोस्।; फाइल चयन गर्नुहोस्।)
- Phrase action buttons as short, polite imperative verbs. Keep the action first and omit explanatory wording that is not needed to identify it. (पज गर्नुहोस्; फेरि प्रयास गर्नुहोस्)
- Use imperative verbs for action menu items; use concise noun phrases for menus that open a view or category. (फाइल खोल्नुहोस्; डाउनलोड इतिहास)
- Phrase check boxes as concise statements of the option’s effect. Do not turn them into questions. (डाउनलोड पूरा भएपछि सूचना देखाउनुहोस्)
- Ask confirmation questions politely and state the action clearly. Use के … चाहनुहुन्छ? where appropriate. (के तपाईं यो फाइल मेटाउन चाहनुहुन्छ?)
- Use short noun phrases for labels and column titles. Nepali has no articles; omit them, and omit postpositions when the meaning remains clear. (फाइल नाम; स्थिति)
- Use the shortest natural form for progress and status. Preserve placeholders exactly, and use a classifier and plural agreement for counted items. (जाँच गर्दै…; {n} वटा डाउनलोड भइरहेका छन्।)
- Use impersonal, concise wording for errors. Keep the error detail after a colon and preserve its placeholder. (खोल्न सकिएन: {error})
- Write event-log entries as brief statements about what happened, without addressing the user. (डाउनलोड सुरु भयो।; फाइल सुरक्षित गरियो।)
- Nepali script has no uppercase or lowercase. Use sentence-style wording for titles rather than imitating English Title Case. (डाउनलोड सेटिङहरू; फाइल जानकारी)
- Use the approved localized names for weekdays and months; do not apply English capitalization rules. Follow the Windows locale’s date format. (आइतबार; जनवरी)
- Use Nepali punctuation consistently: no space before punctuation and one space after it. Use … for an ellipsis and avoid repeated dots. (जाँच गर्दै…; डाउनलोड पूरा भयो।)
- Use standard word spacing, including around placeholders. Do not insert spaces inside a word or separate a punctuation mark from the preceding text. (त्रुटि: {error}; २ वटा फाइल)
- Use quotation marks only when the interface needs to identify literal text. Use Nepali-compatible curly quotation marks and preserve quoted content exactly. (“फाइल खोल्नुहोस्” चयन गर्नुहोस्।)
- Prefer neutral constructions that avoid an unnecessary subject. Make the verb agree naturally with an expressed subject or count. (डाउनलोड पूरा भयो।; ३ वटा फाइल डाउनलोड भइरहेका छन्।)
- Use natural Nepali word order: place modifiers before the noun and put the verb at the end of a sentence. (नयाँ डाउनलोड गरिएको फाइल; यो फाइल खोल्न सकिएन।)
- Use familiar, established technology loanwords in Devanagari rather than forcing uncommon literal translations. Keep product and brand names unchanged. (फाइल; फोल्डर)
- Use अद्यावधिक for update in interface text; use जाँच गर्नुहोस् for checking whether something is available or correct. (अद्यावधिकहरूका लागि जाँच गर्नुहोस्; लिङ्क जाँच गर्नुहोस्)

nl.note: How Dutch writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Gebruik een neutrale, zakelijke en toegankelijke toon. Spreek de gebruiker aan met u; laat de aanspreekvorm weg als dat natuurlijk kan. (Wilt u deze download verwijderen?; Download voltooid.)
- Formuleer opdrachten in menu's en als knopteksten doorgaans met een infinitief, niet als bevel. (Downloaden; Pauzeren)
- Gebruik voor menu-items korte infinitieven of zelfstandige naamwoorden. Houd de formulering gelijk aan die van vergelijkbare opdrachten. (Bestand openen; Instellingen)
- Houd knopteksten beknopt. Gebruik bij bevestigingsknoppen de gebruikelijke korte labels. (Opslaan; Annuleren)

- Formuleer selectievakjes als een korte, duidelijke omschrijving of als een volledige uitspraak. Maak duidelijk wat er wordt in- of uitgeschakeld. (Venster sluiten na downloaden; Meldingen weergeven)
- Stel bevestigingsvragen als volledige, beleefde vragen en sluit ze af met een vraagteken. Laat de knoppen het antwoord geven. (Wilt u deze download annuleren?; Ja)
- Houd veldlabels en kolomkoppen kort en telegraphisch. Laat lidwoorden en voorzetsels weg tenzij ze nodig zijn voor de betekenis. (Bestandsnaam; Downloadlocatie)
- Geef voortgang weer met een natuurlijke Nederlandse werkwoordsvorm en behoud eventuele variabelen. (Controleren…; {n} bestanden worden gedownload)
- Houd statusmeldingen kort. Gebruik een zelfstandig naamwoord of een voltooid deelwoord als de context duidelijk maakt waarop de status slaat. (Download voltooid; Gepauzeerd)

- Formuleer foutmeldingen natuurlijk en zet een toelichting na een dubbele punt. Behoud de betekenis en positie van variabelen waar mogelijk. (Kan niet worden geopend: {error}; Download mislukt: {error})
- Schrijf regels in een gebeurtenislog beknopt en consequent, meestal als korte mededelingen zonder punt. (Download gestart; Download voltooid)
- Laat het werkwoord overeenkomen met het genoemde onderwerp; een weggelaten onderwerp verandert de vervoeging niet. (3 bestanden worden gedownload; Download voltooid)

- Gebruik de gebruikelijke Nederlandse woordvolgorde. Plaats in een werkwoordelijke constructie de hulpwerkwoorden en het voltooid deelwoord in een natuurlijke volgorde. (Het bestand kan niet worden geopend.; De download is voltooid.)
- Gebruik in titels en koppen zinskapitalisatie: alleen het eerste woord en eigennamen krijgen een hoofdletter. (Downloadinstellingen; Controleren op updates)
- Schrijf namen van maanden en weekdagen met een kleine letter, behalve aan het begin van een zin. (maandag 12 mei; De download start op vrijdag.)
- Gebruik Nederlandse interpunctie. Volledige zinnen krijgen een punt; korte labels, statusmeldingen en opdrachten meestal niet. (De download is voltooid.; Downloaden)
- Zet geen spatie vóór een komma, punt, dubbele punt of vraagteken; zet na leestekens waar nodig één spatie. (Fout: {error}; Wilt u doorgaan?)
- Gebruik het beletselteken om aan te geven dat een actie bezig is. Gebruik het teken zonder voorafgaande spatie. (Controleren…; Downloaden…)

- Gebruik aanhalingstekens alleen als ze nodig zijn om tekst letterlijk aan te halen. Gebruik Nederlandse aanhalingstekens en zet leestekens volgens de Nederlandse schrijfwijze. (Het bestand ‘installatie.exe’ is gedownload.; De melding ‘Download voltooid’ wordt weergegeven.)
- Gebruik ingeburgerde leenwoorden waar die gangbaar zijn, maar vertaal gewone opdrachten en systeemtermen. Vermijd onnodige Engelse tekst en Engelse samenstellingen. (downloaden; uploaden)

nn.note: How Norwegian Nynorsk writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Use the imperative for commands and action buttons. Menu items that perform an action use the same form; do not use infinitives as labels. (Opne; Lagre)
- Phrase check boxes as concise statements describing what the setting does. Use sentence case and omit a final full stop. (Start nedlastingar automatisk)
- Address the user as «du» and use a friendly, direct, neutral register. Avoid overly formal or ceremonious wording. (Du kan endre dette seinare.)
- Write confirmation prompts as direct questions, normally with «Vil du …?». Name the action or item clearly. (Vil du avbryte nedlastinga?)
- Keep labels and column titles short, usually as noun phrases without articles. Avoid adding prepositions or explanatory wording unless needed for clarity. (Nedlastingsmappe; Filnamn)

- Use a present-tense verb for an ongoing activity and a concise noun phrase or full clause for a status. Use an ellipsis only when the activity is still in progress. (Kontrollerer …; Nedlastinga pågår.)
- Make count-based status text grammatical without relying on a single form that may not agree with the number. Prefer a plural noun phrase with a verb that agrees. ({n} nedlastingar pågår)
- Turn English error fragments into a natural Nynorsk message. Keep the cause or error detail after a colon, and preserve placeholders exactly. (Kan ikkje opne fila: {error}.)
- Write event-log entries as clear, concise statements, usually in the past tense. Include the item or action where it helps identify the event. (Nedlastinga vart fullført.)
- Use sentence case: capitalise the first word and proper names, but not every word in a title. Write months and weekdays in lowercase. (Innstillingar for nedlasting; måndag 12. juni)
- Do not add a full stop to a button or a short label. Use a full stop for a complete statement and a question mark for a question. (Start; Nedlastinga er fullført.)

- Use a single space between words and after punctuation, but none before commas, full stops, colons or question marks. Use the ellipsis character with a space before it. (Kontrollerer …; Feil: prøv på nytt.)
- Use Norwegian angle quotation marks for quoted text. Do not put interface labels in quotation marks unless referring to their exact wording. (Meldinga «Fila finst ikkje» vart vist.)
- When the subject is understood from context, use a natural verb form for that subject; do not copy an English fragment if it produces awkward or incomplete Nynorsk. (Lastar ned …; Fila er klar.)
- Use natural Nynorsk word order in full sentences, with the finite verb in the usual second position. Do not mirror English word order. (Når nedlastinga er ferdig, opnar fila seg.)

- Prefer established Nynorsk words to English loanwords. Use a loanword only when it is established in the product domain or is part of a name, and use Nynorsk spelling and inflection. (lenkje; innstillingar)

or.note: How Odia writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - କମାଣ୍ଡକୁ ସମ୍ମାନସୂଚକ ଆଜ୍ଞାର୍ଥକ ରୂପରେ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ; ସମ୍ଭବ ହେଲେ କର୍ତ୍ତା ସର୍ବନାମ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ। (ଫାଇଲ୍ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ)
- ବଟନ୍‌ରେ ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟବାଚକ ଶବ୍ଦ ବା ପ୍ରଚଳିତ ଛୋଟ ଲେବଲ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। (ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ; ବାତିଲ୍)
- ମେନୁର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଆଇଟମ୍‌କୁ ଆଜ୍ଞାର୍ଥକ ରୂପରେ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ; ଉପମେନୁ ନାମ ପାଇଁ ବିଶେଷ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। (ଲିଙ୍କ୍ କପି କରନ୍ତୁ; ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ବିକଳ୍ପ)
- ଚେକ୍‌ବକ୍ସ ଲେବଲ୍‌କୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ, ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ବା ସେଟିଂ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା ଭାବେ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ। (ସମାପ୍ତ ହେଲେ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର୍ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ)
- ବ୍ୟବହାରକାରୀଙ୍କୁ ସିଧାସଳଖ ସମ୍ବୋଧନ କରିବା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ହେଲେ ‘ଆପଣ’ ଓ ସମ୍ମାନସୂଚକ କ୍ରିୟାରୂପ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ; ‘ତୁମେ’ ବା ଅତି ଅନୌପଚାରିକ ଭାଷା ଏଡ଼ାନ୍ତୁ। (ଆପଣଙ୍କର ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ଫୋଲ୍ଡର୍ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ)
- ନିଶ୍ଚିତକରଣ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନକୁ ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ଓ ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଚିହ୍ନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। (ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ବାତିଲ୍ କରିବେ କି?)
- ଲେବଲ୍ ଓ ସ୍ତମ୍ଭ ଶୀର୍ଷକ ପାଇଁ ଛୋଟ ବିଶେଷ୍ୟ ବା ବିଶେଷ୍ୟ ବାକ୍ୟାଂଶ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ; ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ଲେଖା ଓ ପୂର୍ବସର୍ଗ ଏଡ଼ାନ୍ତୁ। (ଫାଇଲ୍ ନାମ; ଅବଶିଷ୍ଟ ସମୟ)
- ପ୍ରଗତି ଓ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ଚାଲୁଥିବା କାମକୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରନ୍ତୁ; ଆପ୍‌କୁ ନିହିତ କର୍ତ୍ତା ଭାବେ ଧରିପାରିବେ। (ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରୁଛି...; {n}ଟି ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ଚାଲିଛି)
- ତ୍ରୁଟିର ଖଣ୍ଡବାକ୍ୟକୁ ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ରଖି କାରଣ ବା ବିବରଣୀର କ୍ରମ ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ({error} କାରଣରୁ ଖୋଲିହେଲା ନାହିଁ)
- ଇଭେଣ୍ଟ୍ ଲଗ୍‌ରେ ଘଟଣାକୁ ନିରପେକ୍ଷ, ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ବାକ୍ୟରେ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ; ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ସମ୍ବୋଧନ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ। (ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେଲା)
- ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଲିପିରେ ବଡ଼ ଓ ଛୋଟ ଅକ୍ଷରର ଭେଦ ନାହିଁ। ଶୀର୍ଷକରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଶବ୍ଦକୁ ବଡ଼ ଅକ୍ଷର କରିବା ପରି ଇଂରାଜୀ ଶୈଳୀ ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; ଉତ୍ପାଦ ନାମକୁ ମୂଳ ରୂପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। (ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ସେଟିଂସ୍; Dannex Download Manager)
- ମାସ ଓ ସପ୍ତାହର ଦିନର ନାମ ଓଡ଼ିଆରେ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ; ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବିଶେଷ ଶୀର୍ଷକ ଶୈଳୀ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ। (ଜାନୁଆରୀ; ସୋମବାର)
- ଓଡ଼ିଆ ବାକ୍ୟର ଶେଷରେ ଦଣ୍ଡ (।) ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ; ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଚିହ୍ନ ଓ ଅଧୂରା ପ୍ରଗତି ସୂଚନାରେ ତିନି ବିନ୍ଦୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। (ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ସମାପ୍ତ ହେଲା।; ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରୁଛି...)
- ବିରାମଚିହ୍ନ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; କୋଲନ୍ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ଉଦ୍ଧୃତିଚିହ୍ନ ଏଡ଼ାନ୍ତୁ। (ତ୍ରୁଟି: ଫାଇଲ୍ ମିଳିଲା ନାହିଁ; ‘ସେଟିଂସ୍’ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ)
- କ୍ରିୟାକୁ ତାହାର ନିହିତ କର୍ତ୍ତା ସହ ସମଞ୍ଜସ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ଓଡ଼ିଆରେ ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ନିରପେକ୍ଷ ରୂପ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ଥିଲେ ସେହି ରୂପ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ। (ଫାଇଲ୍ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ହେଉଛି; ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେଲା)
- ଓଡ଼ିଆର ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ କର୍ତ୍ତା–କର୍ମ–କ୍ରିୟା ଶବ୍ଦକ୍ରମ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ପ୍ଲେସ୍‌ହୋଲ୍ଡର୍‌କୁ ଅନୁବାଦ କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧିତ ବାକ୍ୟାଂଶ ପାଖରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ({file} ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍ ହେଲା; {error} ଦେଖାଗଲା)
- ପରିଚିତ ପ୍ରଯୁକ୍ତି ଶବ୍ଦ ପାଇଁ ଚଳିତ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଲିପ୍ୟନ୍ତରଣ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ; ଏକେ ଧାରଣା ପାଇଁ ସମଗ୍ର ଇଣ୍ଟରଫେସ୍‌ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ରୂପ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ସହଜ, ପ୍ରଚଳିତ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଶବ୍ଦ ଥିଲେ ତାହାକୁ ପସନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ। (ଡାଉନଲୋଡ୍; ସେଟିଂସ୍)

rules: - ਕਮਾਂਡਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿੱਧਾ, ਆਦਰ-ਸੂਚਕ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤੋ। (ਲਿੰਕ ਕਾਪੀ ਕਰੋ; ਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਚੁਣੋ)
- ਬਟਨਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਾਰਵਾਈ ਨੂੰ ਛੋਟੇ ਕਿਰਿਆ-ਵਾਕ ਨਾਲ ਦਰਸਾਓ। (ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰੋ; ਰੱਦ ਕਰੋ)
- ਮੀਨੂ ਆਈਟਮਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਕਸਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤੋ; ਬੇਲੋੜੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨਾ ਜੋੜੋ। (ਫੋਲਡਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ; ਨਵਾਂ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਜੋੜੋ)
- ਚੋਣ-ਬਕਸੇ ਦਾ ਲੇਬਲ ਸੈਟਿੰਗ ਜਾਂ ਨਤੀਜਾ ਦੱਸੇ, ਯੂਜ਼ਰ ਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਨਾ ਦੇਵੇ। (ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਣ 'ਤੇ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਦਿਖਾਓ)
- ਯੂਜ਼ਰ ਲਈ ਆਦਰ-ਸੂਚਕ ‘ਤੁਸੀਂ’ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਲ ਖਾਂਦਾ ਬਹੁਵਚਨ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਤੋ; ‘ਤੂੰ’ ਨਾ ਵਰਤੋ। (ਕੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਸ ਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਟਾਉਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ?; ਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਚੁਣੋ)
- ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਵਾਲ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਰਪੱਖ ਰੱਖੋ; ਆਮ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ‘ਕੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ…?’ ਨਾਲ ਬਣਾਓ। (ਕੀ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਰੱਦ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ?)
- ਲੇਬਲ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲਮ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਛੋਟੇ ਨਾਂਵ-ਵਾਕ ਹੋਣ। ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਵਾਂਗ ਲੇਖ ਨਾ ਜੋੜੋ; ਸੰਬੰਧ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੇ ਸੰਬੰਧਕ ਹੀ ਵਰਤੋ। (ਸੇਵ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਟਿਕਾਣਾ; ਸਥਿਤੀ)
- ਪ੍ਰਗਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਚੱਲ ਰਹੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਲਈ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ, ਨਿਰਪੱਖ ਵਾਕ-ਰਚਨਾ ਵਰਤੋ। ਬਦਲਣਯੋਗ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਲੇਸਹੋਲਡਰ ਜਿਉਂ ਦੇ ਤਿਉਂ ਰੱਖੋ। (ਜਾਂਚ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ…; {n} ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਜਾਰੀ ਹਨ)
- ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਦੇ ਅਧੂਰੇ ਵਾਕਾਂਸ਼ ਸੰਖੇਪ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਰਪੱਖ ਰੱਖੋ। ਕਾਰਨ ਜਾਂ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਲਈ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਪਲੇਸਹੋਲਡਰ ਨਾ ਬਦਲੋ। (ਖੋਲ੍ਹਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਿਆ: {error})
- ਇਵੈਂਟ ਲੌਗ ਦੀਆਂ ਲਾਈਨਾਂ ਸੰਖੇਪ ਅਤੇ ਘਟਨਾ-ਕੇਂਦਰਿਤ ਹੋਣ; ਪੂਰਾ ਵਾਕ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਜੋੜੋ। (ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਇਆ; ਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ)
- ਜਿੱਥੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਕਿਰਿਆ ਦਾ ਲਿੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਵਚਨ ਉਸ ਲੁਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਨਾਂਵ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਓ ਜਿਸ ਵੱਲ ਭਾਵ ਇਸ਼ਾਰਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। (ਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਹੋ ਗਈ; ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਇਆ)
- ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਦਾ ਆਮ ਕਰਤਾ–ਕਰਮ–ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸ਼ਬਦ-ਕ੍ਰਮ ਰੱਖੋ। ਪਲੇਸਹੋਲਡਰ ਨੂੰ ਉਸੇ ਥਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਰਹੇ। (ਫ਼ਾਈਲ ਨੂੰ {folder} ਵਿੱਚ ਸੇਵ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ; ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ)
- ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਡੇ ਅਤੇ ਛੋਟੇ ਅੱਖਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ। ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਂਡ ਜਾਂ ਉਤਪਾਦ-ਨਾਂ ਲਿਖਣ ਵੇਲੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਮੂਲ ਲਿਖਤ ਕਾਇਮ ਰੱਖੋ। (Dannex Download Manager; Windows)
- ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਦੇ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਹੀਨਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਂ ਆਮ ਨਾਂਵਾਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਲਿਖੋ; ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਵੱਡੇ ਅੱਖਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਦਰਸਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ। (ਸੋਮਵਾਰ; ਜਨਵਰੀ)
- ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਕ ਦੇ ਅੰਤ 'ਤੇ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਦਾ ਦੰਡ ‘।’ ਵਰਤੋ। ਬਟਨ, ਲੇਬਲ ਅਤੇ ਛੋਟੇ ਸਥਿਤੀ-ਵਾਕਾਂਸ਼ਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਤ 'ਤੇ ਬੇਲੋੜਾ ਵਿਰਾਮ-ਚਿੰਨ੍ਹ ਨਾ ਲਗਾਓ। (ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ।; ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰੋ)

- ਵਾਕ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਕਾਮੇ ਜਾਂ ਕੌਲਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਖਾਲੀ ਥਾਂ ਨਾ ਦਿਓ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਲੀ ਥਾਂ ਦਿਓ। ਜਾਰੀ ਰਹਿਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਕਾਰਵਾਈ ਲਈ ਇਕਸਾਰ ਤਿੰਨ-ਬਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਵਾਲਾ ਚਿੰਨ੍ਹ ਵਰਤੋ। (ਸਥਿਤੀ: ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਜਾਰੀ ਹੈ; ਜਾਂਚ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ…)
- ਹਵਾਲੇ ਲਈ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਪਾਠ ਵਿੱਚ ‘…’ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਵਾਲਾ-ਚਿੰਨ੍ਹ ਵਰਤੋ; ਹਵਾਲੇ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰਲੇ ਵਿਰਾਮ-ਚਿੰਨ੍ਹ ਮੂਲ ਪਾਠ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਰੱਖੋ। (“ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ” ਟੈਬ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ)
- ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪ੍ਰਚਲਿਤ ਤਕਨੀਕੀ ਲੋਨਵਰਡ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਖੋ। ਬਿਨਾਂ ਲੋੜ ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨਾ ਰੱਖੋ; ਜਿੱਥੇ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਅਤੇ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਹੋਵੇ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਤਰਜੀਹ ਦਿਓ। (ਫੋਲਡਰ; ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ)

pl.note: How Polish writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Formułuj polecenia i przyciski jako krótkie czasowniki w trybie rozkazującym, w 2. osobie liczby pojedynczej. Nie dodawaj kropki. (Pobierz; Wstrzymaj)
- Nazwy poleceń w menu zapisuj tak samo jak polecenia na przyciskach. Nazwy kategorii menu mogą być rzeczownikami. (Plik; Otwórz folder)
- Etykiety pól wyboru formułuj zwięźle jako opis ustawienia lub czynności; nie kończ ich kropką. (Uruchamiaj przy starcie systemu; Powiadamiaj o zakończeniu pobierania)

- Zwracaj się do użytkownika bezpośrednio i naturalnie, używając form 2. osoby liczby pojedynczej, gdy zwrot jest potrzebny. W miarę możliwości pomijaj zaimki „ty” i „twoje”. (Wybierz folder docelowy; Twoje pobieranie jest wstrzymane)
- Pytania potwierdzające zaczynaj od „Czy na pewno chcesz…”. Podaj jasno czynność i jej skutek. (Czy na pewno chcesz usunąć pobrany plik?)
- Etykiety i nagłówki kolumn formułuj krótko, zwykle jako rzeczowniki lub określenia rzeczownikowe. Unikaj rodzajników, których polszczyzna nie wymaga, i zbędnych przyimków. (Nazwa pliku; Rozmiar)
- W tekstach postępu stosuj zwięzłe rzeczowniki odczasownikowe lub stabilne konstrukcje, które nie wymagają odmiany placeholdera. (Sprawdzanie…; {n} pobrań w toku)
- Fragmenty błędów tłumacz jako naturalne, bezosobowe zdania. Jeśli tekst jest tylko fragmentem komunikatu, nie dodawaj na końcu kropki. (Nie można otworzyć: {error})
- W dzienniku zdarzeń używaj krótkich, jednoznacznych wpisów; bezosobowe formy czasu przeszłego pomagają uniknąć problemów ze zgodnością rodzaju. (Pobieranie wstrzymano; Plik pobrano)

- W tytułach i nazwach elementów interfejsu stosuj zapis zdaniowy: wielką literą zapisuj pierwszy wyraz oraz nazwy własne, nie każdy wyraz. (Ustawienia pobierania; Menedżer pobierania Dannex Download Manager)
- Nazwy miesięcy i dni tygodnia zapisuj małą literą, także w harmonogramach i datach. (poniedziałek, 12 marca; Pobierz w każdy piątek)

- Stosuj polską interpunkcję: bez spacji przed przecinkiem, kropką, dwukropkiem, średnikiem, znakiem zapytania i wykrzyknikiem; po nich wstawiaj jedną spację. (Błąd: nie można pobrać pliku.; Czy chcesz kontynuować?)
- W tekstach interfejsu nie stawiaj kropki po krótkich etykietach, poleceniach ani nagłówkach. Pełne zdania i komunikaty zapisuj z kropką. (Folder docelowy; Nie można zapisać pliku.)
- Używaj polskich cudzysłowów: otwierającego „ i zamykającego ”. Nie ujmuj w cudzysłów nazw poleceń bez potrzeby. (Plik „raport.zip” jest gotowy.)

- Nie kopiuj angielskiego szyku zdania. Umieszczaj najważniejszą czynność lub informację na początku i dobieraj naturalny polski szyk. (Wybierz folder, w którym zapiszesz plik.; Nie można wznowić pobierania.)
- Gdy podmiot jest domyślny lub nieznany, wybieraj konstrukcje bezosobowe albo takie, w których nie trzeba uzgadniać rodzaju z pominiętym podmiotem. (Pobrano plik; Nie można wznowić)
- Preferuj polskie, utrwalone odpowiedniki. Zapożyczeń używaj tylko wtedy, gdy są powszechne lub stanowią termin produktu; odmieniaj je zgodnie z polską gramatyką. (folderu; linku)
- Odróżniaj „sprawdzić” w znaczeniu zweryfikować od „przetestować” w znaczeniu wypróbować działanie funkcji. (Sprawdź plik; Przetestuj połączenie)

pt.note: How Portuguese (Portugal) writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Use português europeu e a terminologia corrente do Windows: «ficheiro», «ecrã» e «transferir». Evite variantes do português do Brasil. (Transferir ficheiros; Guardar na pasta)
- Formule comandos autónomos com o infinitivo. Mantenha a formulação concisa e use a mesma forma em ações equivalentes. (Abrir; Copiar)
- Nos botões, use normalmente o infinitivo; escolha rótulos breves e claros. (Transferir; Guardar)
- Nos menus, use o infinitivo para ações e nomes para opções ou categorias. Não acrescente ponto final. (Abrir ficheiro; Definições)

- Nas caixas de verificação, prefira uma opção positiva, expressa como ação no infinitivo ou como frase nominal. Não use uma pergunta. (Iniciar as transferências automaticamente; Mostrar notificações)

- Dirija-se ao utilizador de forma cordial e direta. Evite «você» e não varie entre registos formal e informal; prefira instruções neutras ou o imperativo formal quando necessário. (Selecione uma pasta.; Escolha uma opção.)

- Nas confirmações, enuncie claramente a ação e, se necessário, a consequência. Use uma pergunta natural, sem recorrer a «OK?» como pergunta. (Tem a certeza de que pretende eliminar esta transferência?; Eliminar também o ficheiro?)

- Use rótulos e títulos de colunas concisos, sem artigo inicial quando este não for necessário. Inclua preposições para manter a relação clara; não sacrifique a naturalidade por brevidade. (Nome; Pasta de destino)
- Escreva o progresso como uma ação em curso ou como uma quantidade seguida da ação. Evite calcar a ordem inglesa. (A verificar…; {n} ficheiros a transferir)

- Redija erros de forma clara e natural. Para uma mensagem curta equivalente a «could not be opened: {error}», use uma construção impessoal. (Não foi possível abrir: {error}; Não foi possível abrir «{file}»: {error}.)

- Escreva as entradas do registo de eventos como frases breves, com capitalização normal e ponto final. Use o tempo verbal adequado ao evento. (Transferência iniciada.; Ligação ao servidor interrompida.)
- Faça a concordância com o nome subentendido ou expresso, mesmo em estados curtos. Não mantenha a forma inglesa invariável. (Transferência concluída.; Ficheiros transferidos.)
- Use uma ordem de palavras natural em português e coloque as variáveis junto do elemento a que se referem. Não imite a sintaxe inglesa. (Transferir {n} ficheiros; {n} ficheiros transferidos)

- Use maiúscula apenas no início da frase e em nomes próprios. Em títulos e nomes de funcionalidades, aplique capitalização de frase, não maiúsculas em todas as palavras. (Definições de transferência; Procurar atualizações)
- Escreva os dias da semana e os meses com minúscula, exceto no início de uma frase. (segunda-feira, 12 de março; Transferência agendada para terça-feira)
- Use a pontuação portuguesa com moderação. As frases completas levam ponto final; rótulos, comandos e estados curtos normalmente não levam. (Transferência concluída.; Velocidade)

- Não insira espaços antes de vírgulas, pontos, dois-pontos, ponto e vírgula, ponto de interrogação ou ponto de exclamação. Use dois-pontos para introduzir detalhes ou erros. (Erro: {error}; Continuar a transferência?)
- Use aspas angulares para texto citado na interface e não deixe espaços entre as aspas e o texto. (O ficheiro «relatório.zip» já existe.; A opção «Iniciar automaticamente» está ativada.)

- Prefira palavras portuguesas a empréstimos desnecessários. Mantenha siglas e nomes técnicos estabelecidos; explique termos pouco familiares quando o contexto não bastar. (transferência (não «download»); URL)

pt-br.note: How Portuguese (Brazil) writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Use português do Brasil natural, claro e neutro. Prefira construções diretas e evite regionalismos e jargão desnecessário. (Baixar arquivo; O download foi concluído.)
- Dirija-se à pessoa usuária de forma respeitosa e informal, sem usar tu. Evite você quando a frase funcionar sem pronome. (Selecione uma pasta.; Você pode alterar essa opção em Configurações.)
- Formule comandos e itens de menu no infinitivo. Não use ponto final em comandos curtos. (Adicionar download; Abrir pasta)
- Use o infinitivo também nos botões; escolha rótulos curtos e claros. (Salvar; Cancelar)
- Escreva caixas de seleção como opções ou ações no infinitivo, sem tratá-las como comandos dirigidos à pessoa usuária. (Iniciar downloads automaticamente; Mostrar notificações)
- Em perguntas de confirmação, formule a ação com clareza e use uma pergunta direta. Evite perguntas ambíguas. (Deseja excluir este download?; Tem certeza de que deseja sair?)
- Mantenha rótulos e títulos de coluna concisos, geralmente como sintagmas nominais. Use artigos e preposições apenas quando forem necessários para a clareza. (Nome do arquivo; Tamanho)
- Em andamento, use o gerúndio ou uma expressão breve de estado. Represente quantidades de forma natural em português. (Verificando…; {n} downloads em andamento)
- Redija mensagens de erro em português completo e direto; mantenha a causa ou o detalhe variável no lugar do espaço reservado. (Não foi possível abrir: {error}; Falha ao baixar {file}.)
- Escreva linhas do log de eventos de forma concisa e informativa, normalmente indicando a ação ou o resultado. (Download concluído: {file}.; Download pausado: {file}.)
- Quando o sujeito estiver implícito, faça o adjetivo ou particípio concordar com o item a que se refere. (Download concluído; Tarefa concluída)
- Use a ordem natural das palavras em português. Posicione variáveis junto ao termo a que se referem, sem alterar seu conteúdo. (Baixar {file} agora; Velocidade de download: {speed})
- Use maiúscula apenas no início de títulos e frases e em nomes próprios. Meses e dias da semana ficam em minúscula. (Downloads concluídos; segunda-feira, 15 de março)
- Use pontuação de acordo com a função do texto: frases completas levam pontuação final; rótulos e comandos curtos, em geral, não. (O download foi concluído.; Pausar)
- Não insira espaço antes de sinais de pontuação; use um espaço depois de dois-pontos. Use reticências para indicar uma operação em andamento. (Verificando…; Erro: tente novamente.)
- Use aspas duplas curvas para reproduzir texto literal da interface. Não coloque rótulos entre aspas sem necessidade. (Selecione “Salvar”.; Abra Configurações.)
- Prefira termos em português. Mantenha empréstimos já comuns no contexto, como link, e use baixar como verbo quando couber. (Copiar link; Baixar arquivo)

quz.note: How Quechua writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Write commands and action buttons as direct, singular imperatives, usually ending in -y or -chiy. Omit the subject and any polite pronoun. (Uraykachiy; Sayachiy)
- Phrase menu items as concise actions when they trigger an action; keep the same imperative form used on buttons. (Khiputa uraykachiy)
- Make checkbox labels short and state-like or action-oriented. Do not add a full sentence unless the choice needs clarification. (Windowswan qallariy)
- Address the user directly in a neutral, respectful register. Quechua imperatives do not require a formal second-person pronoun; avoid importing Spanish usted. (Akllay; Kay khiputa waqaychay)
- Phrase confirmation prompts as complete questions. Use the direct second-person form for asking what the user wants. (¿Kay khiputa waqaychayta munankichu?)
- Use concise noun phrases for labels and column titles. Quechua has no articles; omit them, and avoid adding prepositions unless the relationship would otherwise be unclear. (Suti; Khipupa sutin)
- Prefer telegraphic wording for column headings and compact UI labels; use a full phrase only when needed to make the meaning unambiguous. (Suti; Uraykachiy pachakuna)
- Render ongoing activity with an ongoing aspect form. Keep progress wording short and avoid adding an English-style subject pronoun. (Qhawachkan…; {n} khipukuna uraykachichkanku)
- Keep error messages grammatical even when they appear as fragments. Put the cause or detail after a colon, and preserve the supplied error placeholder exactly. (Kichariyta mana atirqanchu: {error})
- Use concise past-tense statements for event log entries. Include an actor only when it is needed to distinguish who performed the action. (Uraykachiy tukurqan.)
- Use sentence case, not title case: capitalize the first word and proper names, but not every word in a heading. Write month and weekday names in lowercase. (Khiputa uraykachiy; lunes, enero)

- Follow standard Latin-script punctuation. Use opening and closing question marks for questions; use an ellipsis for ongoing activity only where it helps convey progress. (¿Khiputa waqaychayta munankichu?; Qhawachkan…)
- Use a single space between words and no spaces before grammatical suffixes. Keep placeholders attached to surrounding text only where the source syntax requires it. (khipukuna; {n} khipukuna)
- Use « » for quotation marks in prose where supported. Do not put ordinary UI labels in quotation marks. («Khiputa uraykachiy» nispa akllay.)
- Let the verb ending carry the implied subject and number. Do not add a pronoun merely to make the subject explicit. (Tukurqan.; Khipukuna uraykachichkanku.)
- Keep the usual Quechua order: object and other complements before the verb. Put descriptive modifiers before the noun they modify. (Khiputa uraykachiy; musuq khipu)

- Build compounds from familiar Quechua words where that makes a term clear and compact. Keep established technical loans and product names rather than inventing obscure replacements. (khipu waqaychana; Windows)
- Use the same term for the same feature throughout the app, including in menus, notifications, and logs. (Uraykachiy; Uraykachiy tukurqan.)
- Do not translate a variable, product name, file extension, or protocol name unless the product glossary explicitly provides a localized form. ({n}; Windows)
- Keep status messages factual and brief. Avoid adding a subject or explanatory wording that is not present in the source. (Sayachisqa; Tukurqan)
- Preserve the source message’s distinction between stopping, pausing, and continuing. Do not use one action label for all three. (Samachiy; Sayachiy)

ro.note: How Romanian writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Use the polite second-person plural imperative for instructions addressed to the user. Avoid informal singular forms. (Selectați fișierul.; Introduceți adresa URL.)
- Keep button labels short. Prefer established action nouns or infinitive forms for common actions; use a clear imperative when the button is phrased as an instruction. (Salvare; Anulare)
- Use the same concise action-label style in menus. Keep menu items parallel when they are part of the same group. (Pauză; Reluare)
- Phrase check box labels as short statements or noun phrases, not as questions. Make clear what selecting the box does. (Pornire automată la pornirea Windows; Afișați notificările)

- Address users with the polite plural forms „dvs.” or implied „dumneavoastră”; usually omit the pronoun when the verb form is clear. Maintain a neutral, helpful register. (Selectați folderul în care doriți să salvați fișierele.; Puteți relua descărcarea oricând.)
- Write confirmation prompts as complete, direct questions. Name the action and, where useful, its consequence. (Doriți să opriți descărcarea?; Sigur doriți să ștergeți fișierul?)

- Keep labels and column headings concise, usually as nouns without an article. Use prepositions where needed for natural Romanian; do not force telegraphic wording that obscures meaning. (Nume; Dimensiune)

- Use natural Romanian for progress and status messages. For an action in progress, prefer an impersonal construction with „se”; use an ellipsis only when the message is genuinely ongoing. (Se verifică…; Descărcări în curs: {n})
- Use plural-aware resources for counted items so the noun agrees with the number. Avoid templates that produce forms such as „1 descărcări”. (1 fișier se descarcă; {n} fișiere se descarcă)
- Turn English error fragments into clear Romanian messages. Use a complete construction rather than copying English word order. (Nu s-a putut deschide: {error}.; Fișierul nu a putut fi salvat.)

- Write event log entries as concise, informative statements. Include the relevant item or action when available, and use consistent tense within the log. (Descărcarea fișierului s-a finalizat.; Conexiunea a fost întreruptă.)
- Use sentence case for titles, headings, buttons, and menu items: capitalize the first word and proper names, not every word. (Setări de descărcare; Opțiuni de alimentare)
- Write Romanian month and weekday names with lowercase initial letters, except at the beginning of a sentence. (15 martie; luni)
- Follow Romanian punctuation conventions: do not put a space before punctuation; put one space after it. Use a comma for Romanian decimal fractions. (Descărcare finalizată.; Viteză: 2,5 MB/s)
- Use Romanian quotation marks when quoting text: „…” . Do not add spaces inside quotation marks. (Mesajul „Fișierul există deja” a fost afișat.; Selectați „Reluare”.)

- Romanian can omit the subject when it is clear. Ensure verbs and adjectives still agree with the subject; avoid gendered fragments when the subject is unknown. (Descărcarea s-a finalizat.; Fișierele sunt pregătite.)

- Use natural Romanian word order and place modifiers where they read clearly. Reorder placeholders as needed instead of preserving English syntax. (Se descarcă fișierul {name}.; Au fost găsite {n} rezultate.)

- Prefer established Romanian terms over English borrowings or literal calques. Retain familiar technical loanwords only when they are standard and clearer to users. (descărcare, not „download”; link, not „link de descărcare” when the context already makes that clear)

- Keep terminology and capitalization consistent across the interface, especially for repeated actions and status names. (Use „Reluare” for the same resume action everywhere.; Use „Zonă de notificare” consistently.)

ru.note: How Russian writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Use the infinitive for commands, menu items, and action buttons. In instructions to the user, use the polite plural imperative. (Открыть; Приостановить)
- Phrase check box labels as concise actions or conditions, usually with an infinitive; make clear what enabling the box does. (Запускать при входе в Windows; Показывать уведомления)
- Address the user formally as «вы» when needed. Keep the tone neutral and helpful; omit the pronoun when Russian grammar allows. (Выберите файл; Не удалось подключиться к серверу)
- Write confirmation questions clearly and name the action or object. Avoid vague questions such as «Вы уверены?». Use action-specific buttons. (Удалить этот файл?; Удалить)
- Keep labels and column titles short and use noun phrases. Russian has no articles; omit unnecessary prepositions and verbs. (Имя; Размер)
- Use concise status wording. For ongoing actions, use a noun or an impersonal construction; for counts, provide the correct Russian plural form. (Проверка…; Загружается 1 файл / 2 файла / 5 файлов)
- Keep error fragments grammatical when combined with a detail. Prefer an impersonal construction and identify the object when it helps the user. (Не удалось открыть файл: {error})
- Write event log entries as brief, informative statements. Use a past-tense form that agrees with the named item, or an impersonal construction. (Файл загружен.; Не удалось возобновить загрузку.)
- Use sentence case: capitalize the first word and proper names, not every word in a heading. Write months and weekdays in lowercase. (Параметры загрузки; понедельник, 14 мая)

- Use a period for complete sentences, but not for labels, headings, buttons, or short status fragments. Use an ellipsis for an action that is still in progress, with no preceding space. (Загрузка завершена.; Загрузка…)

- Use Russian angle quotation marks «…» in prose when quotation marks are necessary. Avoid putting UI labels in quotes unless distinguishing them from surrounding text. (Откройте раздел «Параметры».; Выберите «Папка назначения».)
- Follow Russian spacing conventions: put a space between a number and a unit or percent sign, and use a nonbreaking space where the layout supports it. (25 МБ; 100 %)

- Let the verb or participle agree with its stated subject. If the subject is omitted, use a natural impersonal construction rather than a form that suggests the wrong subject. (Загрузка завершена.; Не удалось сохранить файл.)

- Use natural Russian word order. Keep a variable beside the word it qualifies, and place error details after a colon when they are supplemental. (Скорость загрузки: {speed}; Не удалось открыть файл: {error})
- Prefer established Russian technical terms. Use a borrowed word only when it is familiar and clearer than a Russian alternative; do not invent transliterations. (браузер; сервер)
- Use «скачать» or «загрузка» for receiving a file, and describe sending a file to a server as «отправка», so the two directions are not confused. (Скачать файл; Отправка файла на сервер)
- Use «Параметры» for configurable app or system options, in line with Windows terminology. Use «диалоговое окно» for a dialog window. (Открыть параметры; Диалоговое окно выбора папки)

- Use a period for complete statements and a question mark for questions. Do not add a final period to short labels, buttons, or headings. Use an ellipsis character for a continuing operation. (Sťahovanie sa dokončilo.; Zrušiť)

- Follow Slovak spacing and typography. Do not put a space before commas, periods, colons, semicolons, or question marks; use a space after them. Use Slovak quotation marks. (Chyba: súbor sa nenašiel.; Zadajte hodnotu „1“.)
- Make status fragments agree with the implied noun, or include the noun to make the agreement clear. Do not leave a gendered adjective without context. (Sťahovanie pozastavené; Súbor stiahnutý)

- Use natural Slovak word order, placing the action or key information where it is easiest to scan. Keep placeholders next to the words they belong to and do not reorder them if that changes their meaning. (Sťahovanie sa začalo.; Súbor {name} sa nepodarilo otvoriť.)

- Prefer established Slovak Windows terminology to English loanwords. Retain a loanword only when it is established in the product context or is part of a name; explain an unfamiliar technical term on first use if needed. (priečinok, not folder; prepojenie, not link)

- Keep technical identifiers, file names, URLs, and error details unchanged unless the interface explicitly requires localization. Do not translate text supplied by a server or user. (https://example.com/file.zip; {error})
- Distinguish an action from a status: use an infinitive for an available command and an appropriate participle or impersonal phrase for a current state. (Zastaviť sťahovanie; Sťahovanie zastavené)

- Prefer established Swedish terms over English loanwords. Use a loanword only when it is established in Swedish or is a product or technical name; do not invent Swedish spellings of English verbs. (ladda ned; ladda upp)
- Distinguish stopping an operation from cancelling it. Use the term that matches the actual effect. (Stoppa hämtningen; Avbryt dialogrutan)

ta.note: How Tamil writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Commands, buttons, and action menu items use a concise, polite imperative ending in “-வும்”. Use the same wording for the same action wherever it appears. (பதிவிறக்கத்தைத் தொடங்கவும்; கோப்பை நீக்கவும்)
- Checkbox labels name an option or state; do not phrase them as commands or questions. (பதிவிறக்கம் முடிந்ததும் கணினியை அணைக்கவும்; தானாகத் தொடங்கு)

- Do not address the user directly unless needed. When direct address is necessary, use the respectful “நீங்கள்”; keep the register clear and courteous. (கடவுச்சொல்லை உள்ளிடவும்; நீங்கள் தேர்ந்தெடுத்த கோப்புறை)
- Phrase confirmation prompts as direct, neutral questions. Name the action or item so the choice is clear. (இந்தப் பதிவிறக்கத்தை நீக்க வேண்டுமா?; பதிவிறக்கங்களை நிறுத்த வேண்டுமா?)
- Keep labels and column titles brief and telegraphic. Omit articles and sentence-style wording; use a noun or a compact noun phrase. (கோப்பு பெயர்; பதிவிறக்க வேகம்)

- Use a concise present-progressive form for activity statuses. Preserve placeholders exactly and include the item being acted on when it helps clarity. (சரிபார்க்கிறது…; {n} கோப்புகள் பதிவிறக்கப்படுகின்றன)
- Keep error fragments concise and preserve the colon and any error placeholder. Do not add a subject that is absent from the source. (திறக்க முடியவில்லை: {error})
- Write event-log entries as brief, complete records, usually with the event in the past tense. Keep timestamps and separators unchanged. (10:32 — பதிவிறக்கம் நிறைவடைந்தது.)
- Tamil has no uppercase or lowercase. Do not impose English title case on Tamil headings; capitalize English product names only as officially written. (பதிவிறக்க அமைப்புகள்; Windows 11)
- Use Tamil names for months and weekdays. Do not capitalize them; follow the source format for dates and times. (திங்கள்; ஜனவரி)

- Use Tamil punctuation consistently. Do not put a space before punctuation; use one space after it when the sentence continues. Use the ellipsis character for a continuing status. (பதிவிறக்கம் முடிந்தது.; சரிபார்க்கிறது…)
- Use curly double quotation marks around quoted text when needed. Do not add quotation marks to ordinary interface labels. (“பதிவிறக்கம் முடிந்தது” என்ற செய்தி; அமைப்புகள்)

- Tamil often omits an understood subject. Make the verb agree with the stated or implied subject, and avoid adding “நீங்கள்” to status messages. (பதிவிறக்கம் நிறுத்தப்பட்டது.; கோப்புகள் பதிவிறக்கப்படுகின்றன.)

- Use natural Tamil word order, generally placing the object before the verb. Keep placeholders in a position that reads naturally without changing their spelling. (கோப்பைத் திறக்க முடியவில்லை; {n} கோப்புகளைப் பதிவிறக்கவும்)
- Prefer established Tamil equivalents. Retain or transliterate a loanword only when it is familiar or needed for a technical concept; use it consistently. (கோப்புறை; கோப்பு ஹோஸ்டிங் சேவை)
- Preserve variables, format specifiers, and other non-translatable tokens exactly. Do not change their braces, order, or spelling. ({error}; {n})
- Use sentence-ending punctuation for complete messages, but omit it from short labels, button text, and column headings. (பதிவிறக்கம் நிறைவடைந்தது.; பதிவிறக்க வேகம்)

te.note: How Telugu writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Commands use a concise, respectful imperative. Do not add a word for “please.” (డౌన్‌లోడ్‌ను ప్రారంభించండి; లింక్‌ను కాపీ చేయండి)
- Button labels use the same imperative for actions; retain established short labels where appropriate. (సేవ్ చేయండి; సరే)
- Menu items use a short action phrase or noun phrase, consistent with what the item does. (ఫైల్‌ను తెరవండి; సెట్టింగ్‌లు)
- Checkbox labels are brief noun phrases or action phrases, not complete instructions. Keep the checked state clear. (పూర్తయిన డౌన్‌లోడ్‌లను తీసివేయి; Windows ప్రారంభమైనప్పుడు అమలు చేయి)
- Address the user as “మీరు” when needed and use respectful verb forms. Avoid switching to informal address. (మీరు గమ్యం ఫోల్డర్‌ను ఎంచుకోండి; మీరు తర్వాత కొనసాగించవచ్చు)
- Phrase confirmation prompts as direct, neutral questions; do not add unnecessary address or politeness. (డౌన్‌లోడ్‌ను రద్దు చేయాలా?; ఈ ఫైల్‌ను తొలగించాలా?)
- Labels and column titles are compact noun phrases. Telugu has no articles; do not add words corresponding to “a” or “the.” (ఫైల్ పేరు; డౌన్‌లోడ్ వేగం)
- Use Telugu postpositions where needed, rather than copying English preposition order. (ఫోల్డర్‌లో సేవ్ చేయండి; నవీకరణల కోసం తనిఖీ చేయండి)
- Use concise, natural progress and status text. Use an ellipsis only for an action still in progress. (తనిఖీ జరుగుతోంది…; {n} డౌన్‌లోడ్‌లు జరుగుతున్నాయి)
- Keep error fragments concise and preserve the supplied error detail or placeholder after a colon. (తెరవడం సాధ్యం కాలేదు: {error}; డౌన్‌లోడ్ విఫలమైంది: {error})
- Write event log entries as concise statements, usually in the past tense. Keep timestamps and other variables unchanged. (ఫైల్ డౌన్‌లోడ్ పూర్తయింది.; కనెక్షన్ పునరుద్ధరించబడింది.)
- Telugu has no uppercase or lowercase. Do not imitate English title case; use normal Telugu spelling for headings and names. (డౌన్‌లోడ్ చరిత్ర; సాధారణ సెట్టింగ్‌లు)
- Write month and weekday names in Telugu without capitalization. Use the product’s established date format consistently. (జనవరి; సోమవారం)

- Use punctuation naturally in Telugu. Do not put a space before punctuation; use a space after it when the sentence continues. (ఫైల్‌ను తెరవలేకపోయింది: {error}; పూర్తయింది. తర్వాతి ఫైల్‌ను ప్రారంభిస్తోంది.)
- Use the single ellipsis character (…) for ongoing activity. Avoid repeated dots and unnecessary exclamation marks. (కనెక్ట్ అవుతోంది…; డౌన్‌లోడ్ పూర్తయింది.)
- Avoid quotation marks in UI labels. If a quotation is necessary in explanatory text, use Telugu double quotation marks consistently. (“డౌన్‌లోడ్” ఎంచుకోండి; ఫైల్ పేరు)
- When the subject is understood, omit it only if the Telugu verb remains clear and natural. Prefer neutral constructions when agreement would be awkward. (పూర్తయింది; తనిఖీ జరుగుతోంది)
- Use natural Telugu word order, generally placing the verb at the end. Keep variables next to the words they modify. (ఫైల్‌ను ఫోల్డర్‌లో సేవ్ చేయండి; {n} ఫైల్‌లు డౌన్‌లోడ్ అవుతున్నాయి)

- Use familiar Telugu-script loanwords for established software terms. Do not leave common terms in Latin script; preserve product names, file extensions, and technical identifiers. (ఫోల్డర్; బ్రౌజర్)
- Preserve placeholders exactly, including braces and format tokens. Do not translate or reorder them if that would break the displayed value. ({n} డౌన్‌లోడ్‌లు; తెరవడం సాధ్యం కాలేదు: {error})

th.note: How Thai writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - เขียนคำสั่งเป็นคำกริยาสั้น ๆ โดยละประธานและคำลงท้ายสุภาพ (ดาวน์โหลด; เพิ่มลิงก์)
- ใช้คำกริยาแสดงการกระทำบนปุ่มให้กระชับ ไม่เติมเครื่องหมายวรรคตอน (เริ่ม; ยกเลิก)
- รายการเมนูใช้ชื่อสิ่งของหรือคำกริยาตามหน้าที่ของรายการ และไม่ใส่จุดท้าย (ไฟล์; เริ่มดาวน์โหลด)
- ป้ายกำกับกล่องกาเครื่องหมายเขียนเป็นข้อความบอกตัวเลือกหรือผลลัพธ์ ไม่ใช้คำสั่ง (เริ่มดาวน์โหลดเมื่อเพิ่มลิงก์; แสดงการแจ้งเตือนเมื่อดาวน์โหลดเสร็จ)
- ใช้สำนวนสุภาพ เป็นกลาง และตรงไปตรงมา ไม่เรียกผู้ใช้ว่า คุณ เว้นแต่จำเป็นต่อความชัดเจน และไม่ใช้ ครับ หรือ ค่ะ (ป้อน URL; บันทึกการตั้งค่าแล้ว)
- เขียนคำถามยืนยันอย่างชัดเจนด้วย ต้องการ…หรือไม่ และหลีกเลี่ยงถ้อยคำตำหนิผู้ใช้ (ต้องการลบรายการดาวน์โหลดนี้หรือไม่)
- ป้ายกำกับและหัวคอลัมน์ใช้วลีสั้น ๆ ไม่ใส่คำนำหน้านาม และไม่เติมคำเชื่อมที่ไม่จำเป็น (ชื่อไฟล์; ขนาด)
- เขียนสถานะหรือความคืบหน้าด้วย กำลัง ตามด้วยคำกริยา; ใช้จุดไข่ปลาเมื่อกระบวนการยังดำเนินอยู่ (กำลังตรวจสอบ...; กำลังดาวน์โหลด {n} รายการ)
- เขียนข้อความผิดพลาดให้เป็นธรรมชาติและคงความหมายของส่วนแปรผันไว้ โดยไม่เติมประธานที่ไม่จำเป็น (ไม่สามารถเปิดได้: {error})
- บันทึกเหตุการณ์ใช้ถ้อยคำสั้น ชัด และบอกผลหรือการกระทำโดยตรง (ดาวน์โหลดไฟล์เสร็จแล้ว; หยุดดาวน์โหลดชั่วคราว)
- ภาษาไทยไม่มีตัวพิมพ์ใหญ่หรือตัวพิมพ์เล็ก จึงไม่ต้องปรับรูปคำตามตัวพิมพ์; คงรูปชื่อผลิตภัณฑ์ภาษาอังกฤษตามชื่อทางการ (Dannex Download Manager; Windows 11)
- ใช้ชื่อเดือนและวันในสัปดาห์ภาษาไทยตามปกติ ไม่ใช้รูปแบบตัวพิมพ์ใหญ่หรือตัวพิมพ์เล็ก (วันจันทร์; มกราคม)
- ใช้เครื่องหมายวรรคตอนเท่าที่จำเป็น; ไม่ใส่จุดท้ายปุ่ม ป้ายกำกับ หรือรายการเมนู (ดาวน์โหลดเสร็จแล้ว; ไม่สามารถเชื่อมต่อได้: {error})
- ไม่เว้นวรรคภายในคำหรือระหว่างคำไทยที่เป็นวลีเดียวกัน; เว้นวรรคคั่นวลีหรือประโยค และคั่นข้อความไทยกับตัวแปรเมื่อช่วยให้อ่านง่าย (กำลังดาวน์โหลด {n} รายการ; บันทึกแล้ว เปิดโฟลเดอร์)
- ใช้เครื่องหมายอัญประกาศโค้ง “ ” เมื่อต้องยกข้อความที่ผู้ใช้เห็นหรือป้อน; ไม่ใส่อัญประกาศรอบชื่อปุ่มหรือเมนูโดยไม่จำเป็น (ไม่พบ “ดาวน์โหลดด่วน”; เลือก เริ่ม)
- ละประธานที่เข้าใจได้จากบริบท; คำกริยาภาษาไทยไม่ผันตามเพศ จำนวน หรือบุคคล (กำลังดาวน์โหลด; หยุดชั่วคราวแล้ว)
- เรียงประโยคตามธรรมชาติของภาษาไทย โดยวางคำขยายหลังคำนาม และใช้ลักษณนามหลังจำนวนเมื่อต้องระบุจำนวนรายการ (ความเร็วในการดาวน์โหลด; {n} รายการที่เสร็จแล้ว)
- เลือกคำไทยที่เข้าใจง่ายก่อน; ใช้คำทับศัพท์ที่คุ้นเคยในบริบทเทคโนโลยีอย่างสม่ำเสมอ และไม่สลับกับคำอังกฤษโดยไม่มีเหตุผล (ลิงก์; โฟลเดอร์)
- ใช้รูปแบบข้อความให้สม่ำเสมอในหน้าจอเดียวกัน โดยเฉพาะคำกริยาสำหรับการกระทำเดียวกัน (ใช้ “หยุดชั่วคราว” ทุกจุดสำหรับ Pause; ใช้ “ดำเนินการต่อ” ทุกจุดสำหรับ Resume)

tr.note: How Turkish writes Dannex Download Manager: sent with every translation request in this language (lingo.style). Learned from reviews in the model's knowledge, not yet reviewed; a person checks every rule.
rules: - Komutlarda arayüz boyunca tutarlı, kısa emir biçimi kullanın; zamir eklemeyin. (İndirmeyi başlat; Bağlantıyı kopyala)
- Düğme metinlerinde eylemi doğrudan ifade edin. Kısa ve yerleşik eylem adları kullanın. (Kaydet; Duraklat)
- Menü öğelerinde komut biçimini koruyun; aynı eylemi düğmelerden farklı çevirmeyin. (Tümünü seç; Klasörü aç)
- Onay kutularında seçildiğinde gerçekleşecek eylemi veya etkin durumu açıkça belirtin. (İndirme tamamlandığında dosyayı aç; Bildirimleri göster)

- Kullanıcıya doğrudan hitap etmeyin; arayüzde zamirsiz ve tarafsız bir dil kullanın. Yardım metninde gerekiyorsa saygılı siz biçimini tercih edin. (Dosyayı seçin.; İndirme konumunu değiştirebilirsiniz.)
- Onay sorularını kısa, tarafsız ve soru işaretiyle biten bir cümle olarak yazın. (İndirme iptal edilsin mi?; Dosya silinsin mi?)
- Etiketlerde ve sütun başlıklarında artikel kullanmayın; kısa ad öbeklerini tercih edin. Gereksiz edat ve açıklamalardan kaçının. (İndirme konumu; Dosya adı)
- İşlem sürerken kısa, öznesiz durum ifadeleri ve üç nokta kullanın. Sayıdan sonra Türkçede çoğul eki getirmeyin. (Denetleniyor…; {n} dosya indiriliyor)
- Durum mesajlarında tamamlanmış işlemi kısa ve doğal biçimde anlatın; gereksiz özne eklemeyin. (İndirme tamamlandı.; Bağlantı kopyalandı.)
- Hata metninde önce sonucu, gerekiyorsa ardından iki nokta üst üste ile ayrıntıyı verin. Yer tutucuları olduğu gibi koruyun. (Açılamadı: {error}; {file} indirilemedi.)
- Olay günlüklerinde kişiye seslenmeyin; olayları kısa, nesnel ve tercihen geçmiş zamanla kaydedin. (İndirme başlatıldı: {file}; Bağlantı denetlendi.)
- Başlıklarda cümle düzeninde büyük harf kullanın: yalnızca ilk sözcüğü ve özel adları büyük yazın. (İndirme ayarları; Yeni indirme)
- Ay ve gün adlarını cümle başında olmadıkça küçük harfle yazın. (12 mayıs; pazartesi günü)

- Noktalama işaretlerini Türkçe yazım kurallarına göre kullanın: işaretten önce boşluk bırakmayın, sonrasında bir boşluk bırakın. Tam cümleleri noktayla bitirin; kısa arayüz etiketlerine nokta eklemeyin. (İndirme tamamlandı.; İndirme konumu)
- Üç nokta yerine tek karakterli üç nokta (…) kullanın. Tırnak gereken yerlerde Türkçe tipografik çift tırnakları tercih edin. (Bağlantı denetleniyor…; “İndirmeyi başlat” seçeneği)
- Özel ada gelen çekim ekini kesme işaretiyle ayırın; ürün adlarını değiştirmeyin. (Windows'ta; Dannex Download Manager'ı)
- Özne bağlamdan belliyse Türkçede özneyi düşürebilirsiniz; yüklemi özneyle uyumlu kurun. Sayı bildiren çoğul öznelerle genellikle tekil yüklem kullanın. (İndirme duraklatıldı.; 3 dosya indiriliyor.)
- Türkçenin doğal özne-nesne-yüklem sırasını izleyin; İngilizce sözcük dizilişini korumayın. (Dosya indiriliyor.; Bağlantıyı şimdi denetle.)
- Yerleşik Türkçe karşılığı bulunan İngilizce sözcükleri kullanmayın. Kaçınılmaz teknik terimleri tutarlı kullanın; ürün ve dosya adlarını çevirmeyin. (klasör (folder değil); Dannex Download Manager)
- Sayı ve ölçü birimi arasında boşluk bırakın; Türkçe sayı ve yüzde yazımını kullanın. (10 MB; %50)

- Eylem türlerini birbirinden ayırın: bir ayarı gözden geçirmek için denetlemek, doğruluğunu teyit etmek için doğrulamak, işlevi denemek için test etmek uygundur. (Güncelleştirmeleri denetle; Dosya bütünlüğünü doğrula)
